code:
from pyspark.sql.functions import col, when

trips = trips.withColumn(
  "trip_size",
  when(col("trip_distance") > 10, "long")
  .otherwise("short"),
)
caption: when() is the "if", .otherwise() is the "else" — one expression, together.
Checked top to bottom — first match wins. Order matters.

code:
trips.withColumn(
  "trip_size",
  when(col("trip_distance") > 10, "long"),
  # no .otherwise() --
)
# unmatched rows become NULL, not an error
caption: A genuine, easy-to-miss source of unexpected nulls — see Lesson 51.
